verdict.rationale: An interactive API reference is a fair question for an accounting SaaS like Wave, so the axis applies. The evidence only notes that a developer portal hosting a GraphQL API exists but returned 403 and could not be read. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
